signals.title: Holders ~40% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.6: price is 40% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.522). Yet 61% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 0.63→0.6 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -86% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: -84% below trend AND fear at 29
signals.detail: Deep in the Fire Sale band (-84% vs the power-law fair value $2.018) with Fear & Greed at 29. Valuation and sentiment bottoming together.
signals.framing: Where value and fear overlap — historically the account's best-resonating zone.
